mode.title: Mode
mode.description: "List" scrapes one of CPBN's public "Bids" listing pages (every row comes back in one response, no pagination). "Detail" fetches the full per-bid detail page for specific bid IDs/URLs.

listType.title: List type (mode=list only)
listType.description: Which CPBN "Bids" listing to scrape. "Open" = currently accepting submissions (can genuinely be empty between announcements). "All" = the full historical archive (largest, 600+ records).

maxResults.title: Max results (mode=list only)
maxResults.description: Caps how many rows are kept from the listing. The full listing always downloads in one request (CPBN embeds every row server-side); this only trims the output, it doesn't reduce the number of requests made.

bidId.title: Bid ID or URL (mode=detail only)
bidId.description: A single CPBN bid's numeric id (e.g. 109), or its full bid URL. Find IDs from a 'list' mode run's bidUrl/bidId fields.

bidIds.title: Bid IDs or URLs (mode=detail only)
bidIds.description: Multiple CPBN bid ids (or full bid URLs) to fetch full detail for in one run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers (mode=detail only)
maxConcurrency.description: How many bid detail pages to fetch in parallel.
